resources.string: On your computer, open Settings → Remote access and copy the address shown there, or scan the pairing QR code and paste the link.

• From anywhere with Tailscale (recommended): on the computer, Settings → Remote access → Tailscale walks you through it. On this phone, install the Tailscale app, sign in with the same account as the computer and switch it on. Then enter https://your-pc.tailXXXX.ts.net (the address the computer shows). • Your Cloudflare address: https://siren.example.com • Same Wi-Fi only: http://192.168.x.x:7823 (not encrypted, no push-to-talk)
Nothing to paste. Copy the address or the QR link first.
Enter an address starting with https:// or http://

This is a Tailscale address. Check, in this order: 1. The Tailscale app on this phone says Connected, signed in with the same account as the computer. 2. The computer is on, Siren is running, and Tailscale says Connected there too. 3. On the computer, Settings → Remote access → Tailscale: every step has a ✓ (if Serve or HTTPS is missing, the button there sets it up).
This local address only works on the same Wi-Fi as the computer, with remote access on and \"Reachable from other devices on my network\" enabled.
Connected: approvals and replies arrive here
This phone was disconnected from the assistant. Open the app to pair again.
